source.prompt: (the chestnut-backed chickadee's) A chestnut-backed chickadee (Poecile rufescens), a tiny songbird about 11 cm long, one adult perched with its wings folded tight against the body, side-on pose. A round fluffy body, a big round head, a tiny short black bill, a medium-long narrow tail. A sooty dark brown cap and a black bib, bright white cheeks, a rich chestnut back and flanks, grey wings and tail, a white belly. Thin dark legs, three toes forward and one back. No base, no perch. Game-ready, clean closed mesh.

tiers.note: A variant of the chestnut-backed chickadee's Meshy preview (no credits), scaled to 0.15 m, the chickadee's tail replaced by a square 6.5 cm tail 12 degrees below level with white outer tail feathers (an outer strip each side, above and below, lod0 and lod1). Colours (Oregon male): black hood over the head, nape, throat and upper breast; rusty-brown back, grey rump; pinkish-buff flanks; white belly; dark grey-brown wings with brown edges (lod0); dark grey tail; pale pink bill (the chickadee's short conical bill), pinkish legs. Triangles: lod0 999 = 814 body + 185 legs, tail, cards, eyes; lod1 399 = 278 body + 121 legs, tail, cards, eyes; lod2 119 = 92 body + 27 legs, tail, cards, eyes. GLB 172,924 bytes. lod_m is a suggestion.

rig: bird rig template of the Steller's jay (tools/build_stellersjay.py; drawn with client/src/animalModels.js RIG.stjay's constants): PART BODY 0, LEG_A 1 / LEG_B 2 procedural legs (pivot at the knee), TAIL 3 procedural tail (pivot at the rump), HEAD 6 (head and neck, pivot at the base of the neck), WING_L/R 4/5 and HAND_L/R 9/10 flight cards that collapse into the shoulder on pose; extras.rig {kind 'bird', wing (shoulder), tail (rump), head (neck base), length_m}; no skin
accuracy_notes: Built 2026-11-05. Reads as an Oregon junco: black hood, rusty back, pink flanks, pink bill, white tail edges. Still open: the bill is the chickadee's, a touch thin for a junco's cone; the eye is lost in the black hood (as on the real bird at distance); the tail is a flat plate, thin side-on.
